sources.title: Google Scholar
sources.snippet: Google Scholar provides a simple way to broadly search for scholarly literature. Search across a wide variety of disciplines and sources: articles, theses, books, abstracts and court opinions.

sources.title: arXiv.org e-Print archive
sources.snippet: arXiv is a free distribution service and an open-access archive for nearly 2.4 million scholarly articles in the fields of physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering and systems science, and economics. Materials on this site are not peer-reviewed by arXiv.

sources.title: 12 Best AI Detectors | Free & Premium Tools Tested (2026 Guide) - Scribbr
sources.snippet: The best free AI detectors (2026) are Scribbr and QuillBot, both correctly identified 78% of our testing texts. The most accurate AI Detector is Scribbr.

sources.title: ClosedReview — Anonymous Academic Community for Researchers
sources.snippet: An anonymous forum where PhD students and researchers discuss papers, job hunting, advisors, and university programs.
